prompt:
USE: A flat game decal for the face of a small wall clock outside a clockmaker's shop. Straight-on orthographic view, no perspective.
SUBJECT: A circular clock dial centred in a square frame, filling 92 percent of the width. A thin aged-brass bezel. Inside it, an ivory enamel dial with fine age crazing, twelve slim dark-bronze bars for the hours and a fine ring of small minute ticks. Two slim dark blued-steel hands set to ten past ten, and a small brass centre cap. No numerals and no letters.
STYLE: Photographic realism with restraint. Ivory enamel with a soft satin sheen, aged brass with soft warm tarnish. Soft, even, shadowless light from all sides. No mirror reflections, no glow, so the colours read as base colour.
CONSTRAINTS: Fully transparent background outside the bezel, with a crisp edge and no halo. Do not draw a checkerboard, a backdrop, a wall or a drop shadow. No text of any kind, no numerals. No logos, no watermarks. Original design only.
